full_translation_en:
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 62
Daily Agenda
Federal
Parliament of Nepal
Monday, October 12, 2083
11:00 AM
Management Work
1. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister Balendra Shah, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam:-
   a) Proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Some Nepal Laws Arrangement and Operation Bill, 2083"
   b) To introduce the "Some Nepal Laws Arrangement and Operation Bill, 2083".
2. The Honourable Minister for Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, Sita Badi:-
   a) To present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws on Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, 2083".
   b) To introduce the "Bill to Amend Some Nepal Laws on Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security, 2083".
3. The Honourable Minister for Health and Food Hygiene, Nisha Mehta:-
   a) To present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Objects (Control of Sale and Distribution) (First Amendment) Bill to Replace Breast Milk, 2083".
   b) To introduce the "Objects (Control of Sale and Distribution) (First Amendment) Bill to Replace Breast Milk, 2083".
   c) To present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Safe Motherhood and Reproductive Health Rights (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   d) To introduce the "Safe Motherhood and Reproductive Health Rights (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   e) To present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Health Workers and Health Institutions Security (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   f) To introduce the "Health Workers and Health Institutions Security (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
   g) To present the proposal to seek permission to introduce the "Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Science Academy Bill, 2083".
   h) To introduce the "Ramraja Prasad Singh Health Science Academy Bill, 2083".

Panch Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.summary_en: The agenda for the day included management work. Several bills were proposed for introduction, covering legal reforms, women and child security, health, and a health science academy.
